union.reason: Include/exclude filters are applied before union; the duplicate shared Item is retained once.

intersection.reason: Both filtered operand populations contain the shared Item.

difference.reason: The right filtered population is removed from the left population.

single-union.reason: A single union operand is valid and returns that operand after its include filter.

single-intersection.reason: A single intersection operand is valid and returns that operand after its include filter.

single-difference.reason: A single difference operand is valid and returns that operand after its include filter.

nested-predicate.reason: The nested difference removes the right population after the AND filter selects left-a; the outer union restores the right population.

empty-filter.reason: A collected population with no matching Item satisfies items_found: none; it is distinct from absent acquisition.

reason: The abstract deterministic populations independently justify Set cardinalities, nested operand membership, logical filter predicates, and empty collected results; collector status propagation and capability-specific filter semantics remain separate.
